description: Ad-hoc report: pick a source, metrics, dimensions and filters. Sources and fields — deliveries: metrics sent, delivered, failed, opened, clicked, delivery_rate, open_rate, click_rate, failure_rate; dimensions day/week/month/channel/provider/campaign/status. events: metrics count, unique_users, value_sum, value_avg; dimensions day/week/month/name/source. conversions: metrics conversions, revenue, unique_users; dimensions day/week/month/campaign/event_name/kind. Do not combine `days` with `from`/`to`. Required scope: analytics:read.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

name: run_report
title: Run report
